expression_transform: none; operate directly on provided finite nonnegative X values; no exp, no re-normalization, no inferred log base or raw count
exclusion_list: not applied: this is not reproduction of official filtered DE. Preserve provenance and membership audit. No claim that its effect is negligible; source-defined unfiltered measurement is the scope.

control_partition.algorithm: within each exact vehicle pool sort all obs_id by SHA256(seed|obs_id), break ties by obs_id; assign alternating positions A and B; retain all cells
control_partition.interpretation: disjoint cell subsets of ONE physical vehicle well; sampling separation only, shared well and upstream biological/technical variation remain

measurement_admission: at least20 provided treated cells AND a unique exact matched vehicle pool with at least40; keep all other measurements and reasons in exclusion manifest
measurement_effect: mean(provided X over admitted treated measurement) minus mean(provided X over matched control-B cells)
atomic_effect: equal-weight mean of admitted measurement effects within each atomic key; no cell-count weighting across wells
source_state_A: equal-weight mean of A-cell means over ALL count-eligible vehicle wells in each donor_id/cell_type, independent of retained drugs and queried library; constant across drugs of that donor/type

tasks.name: donor_held_out_within_fixed_source_annotated_cell_type
tasks.source_rule: two donor contexts only within same fixed cell type; all treated responses of third donor withheld
tasks.query_rule: observed drug-dose-time atom with at least one admitted measurement in each of all three donors; exact common support, never impute absent atoms
tasks.type_admission: at least20 common source compound IDs at one fixed dose/time; determine from metadata only, report unsupported types
tasks.scope: retrospective source RNA-derived cell-type labels; donor and nested plate/library joint shift, NOT pure donor effect, unseen-cell-line claim, or cross-study trained model transfer

feature_selection.fit_scope: all A-control cells from the TWO source donors of the fixed cell type; no target-A cells and no treated responses
feature_selection.candidate_axis: all21255 unique source gene rows as provided; this is not a claim about the original normalization denominator
feature_selection.variance: cell-pooled population variance on unchanged provided X; float64 sums and squared sums, ddof0
feature_selection.order: positive variance descending, then original source_feature_row ascending
feature_selection.insufficient_features: fail task if fewer than3000 positive-variance source-control genes; no target-driven fill

endpoints.gene_scope: one fixed cell_type, heldout donor, dose and time; unique source compounds; no dose/time/donor pooling to meet count
endpoints.single_Belinostat_dose: eligible for condition errors if common across donors; gene ranking at0.1uM unsupported when below20 compounds
endpoints.constant_prediction: Spearman remains NA, pair ordering0.5 for distinguishable true pairs
endpoints.inference: descriptive paired effects with explicit denominators; no cell-based p values and no treatment of gene/pair/cell counts as independent biological replicates
endpoints.cross_study: never average absolute MAE between studies with different expression units; compare within-study paired baselines and directions

decoder.landmarks: source-only hash order with at least one atom per source entity then fill; if fewer source atoms than256 use all, retain actual dimension
decoder.language_models: same six frozen encoders and pooling as sciplex core; source_name entity+exposure only
decoder.method_registry: 22settings: zero,source_mean,source_median,same_drug_source_mean; identity,TF-IDF,Morgan and sixLLM entity+exposure each direct and product-with-state
decoder.same_drug_source_mean: equal mean of the two source donor atomic effects at exactly the same source compound ID,dose,time within fixed cell type; source responses only
decoder.controls_permissions: target control-A state available only to named control-state methods, control-B only in target truth

execution_gates: metadata source identity, drug/dose/unit mapping, vehicle roles and actual common-support cohort validated
exact control A/B cell membership frozen before reading new treated values
input X full relevant-cell finite/nonnegative/positive-expression checks and declared sparse-format integrity
source-only feature selections saved before query truths exposed to fitting
frozen predictions before scoring; independent numerical QA before manuscript reporting
not_completed_by_this_file: new clean text registry or embeddings
